interpretation: WT control is a real observable intervention and modulates an anonymous response signature, but the frozen diagnostic neither generalizes beyond the shuffled-control bound nor supports conditional independence. The three-family interface has common temporal containers but no common auxiliary semantics; masks instead provide a prohibited family classifier. Existing cohorts therefore cannot identify the proposed cross-world causal representation without adding assumptions or ontology.
